SELECT history_date, history_type, history_content, point_change FROM (
(SELECT created_date AS history_date, '지급' AS history_type, '기초 회원가입 지원 포인트' AS history_content, 30000 AS point_change FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT cp.created_date AS history_date, '쿠폰' AS history_type, cp.name AS history_content, -cp.price AS point_change FROM coupon_purchase cp WHERE cp.student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT gp.created_date AS history_date, '지급' AS history_type, gp.content AS history_content, gp.point AS point_change FROM get_points gp WHERE gp.student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT t.created_date AS history_date, '매수' AS history_type, s.name AS history_content, -(o.price * o.amount) AS point_change FROM stock_transactions t JOIN orders o ON t.buy_order_id = o.order_id JOIN stocks s ON o.stock_id = s.stock_id WHERE o.student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT t.created_date AS history_date, '매도' AS history_type, s.name AS history_content, (o.price * o.amount) AS point_change FROM stock_transactions t JOIN orders o ON t.sell_order_id = o.order_id JOIN stocks s ON o.stock_id = s.stock_id WHERE o.student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT o.created_date AS history_date, '매수예약' AS history_type, CONCAT(s.name, ' 매수 예약') AS history_content, -(o.price * o.amount) AS point_change FROM orders o JOIN stocks s ON o.stock_id = s.stock_id WHERE o.student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1) AND o.content = '매수' AND o.state = '대기'
UNION ALL
SELECT o.created_date AS history_date, '주문취소' AS history_type, CONCAT(s.name, ' 매수 취소 (환불)') AS history_content, (o.price * o.amount) AS point_change FROM orders o JOIN stocks s ON o.stock_id = s.stock_id WHERE o.student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1) AND o.content = '매수' AND o.state = '취소'
) history ORDER BY history_date DESC
